# Cloudless — full index

Websites, cloud infrastructure, and AI automations for small teams that have
been let down before — fixed scope, no lock-in, measurable results in 14 days.

- https://cloudless.gr/en — homepage
- https://cloudless.gr/en/services — service packages & pricing

- https://cloudless.gr/en/docs — documentation hub
- https://cloudless.gr/en/campaigns — marketing campaigns
- https://cloudless.gr/en/dashboard — client dashboard (auth required)
- https://cloudless.gr/en/contact — contact + free 30-minute audit booking
- https://cloudless.gr/links — link-in-bio / lead-magnet hub

## Public JSON APIs (see /.well-known/api-catalog)

- GET https://cloudless.gr/api/docs — documentation index (grouped by category)
- POST https://cloudless.gr/api/chat — assistant chat endpoint
- GET https://cloudless.gr/api/health — liveness/status
- GET https://cloudless.gr/api/calendar/availability — consultation slots
- POST https://cloudless.gr/api/calendar/book — consultation booking

- https://cloudless.gr/.well-known/api-catalog — RFC 9727 linkset catalog
- https://cloudless.gr/.well-known/ai-catalog.json — ARD capability manifest
- https://cloudless.gr/.well-known/agent-skills/index.json — Agent Skills index
- https://cloudless.gr/.well-known/openid-configuration — OIDC discovery
- https://cloudless.gr/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource — RFC 9728 PRM
- https://cloudless.gr/.well-known/poppy.json — Poppy discovery metadata
- https://cloudless.gr/.well-known/security.txt — security contact policy
- https://cloudless.gr/auth.md — agent authentication guide
- https://cloudless.gr/robots.txt — crawler + AI-bot rules + Content-Signals
- https://cloudless.gr/sitemap.xml — URL sitemap

## Content negotiation

GET/HEAD requests with `Accept: text/markdown` receive a Markdown
representation (`Content-Type: text/markdown`, `x-markdown-tokens` header).
HTML remains the default.
